purpose: Controlled card benefit ingestion contract for Selenium-based public card benefit collection.

endpoints.name: Search card catalog
rules: Catalog search can return unverified Selenium candidates.
Catalog results are not user-owned cards until the user confirms one through /me/cards/from-catalog/.

endpoints.name: Create my card from catalog
rules: The user must explicitly confirm a catalog card before it becomes a CardPolicy.
The created CardPolicy must use source_type=selenium.
The created CardPolicy must use verification_status=user_confirmed.
The created CardPolicy is owned by the authenticated user.
The user may override discount and limit fields before saving.

endpoints.name: Discover card benefit candidates from allowed public domain

domain.description: Optional domain selected from backend allowlist. The backend must not invent domains.

rules: Selenium ingestion only targets the user-approved default domain card-search.naver.com or domains explicitly present in CARD_INGESTION_ALLOWED_DOMAINS.
The first approved source URL is https://card-search.naver.com/list?companyCode=&brandNames=&benefitCategoryIds=1&sortMethod=ri&isRefetch=true&bizType=CPC.
If no domain is configured or provided, return an empty candidate list with provider_status=allowlist_required.
If the requested domain is outside the allowlist, return an empty candidate list with provider_status=domain_not_allowed.
Candidates from Selenium ingestion must use source_type=selenium and verification_status=unverified.
Unverified candidates must not affect recommendation ranking.
Do not collect payment credentials, card numbers, CVC, resident registration numbers, or private account data.

commands.name: ingest_card_search
commands.description: Uses Selenium to collect public card benefit candidates from an allowlisted card-search domain into CardCatalog as unverified records.

arguments.--url: Required. Must resolve to card-search.naver.com or another allowlisted domain.
arguments.--limit: Optional maximum number of candidates to save.
arguments.--detail: Optional. Visit each candidate detail URL and enrich CardCatalog fields from public benefit text.
arguments.--dry-run: Collect and print candidates without saving.

rules: The command must reject domains outside the allowlist.
The --detail option must only visit candidate detail URLs on an allowlisted domain.
Detail parsing results must be saved only to CardCatalog.
The command must save candidates as source_type=selenium and verification_status=unverified.
The command must not collect payment credentials or private account data.
The command must not run from recommendation request handling.
